welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Co:p\u003E\u003C\/o:p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"MsoNormal\"\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"MsoNormal\"\u003EI’ve been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of “patient clinical data analysis” to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history , clinical findings , investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E60 year old female came with chief complaints of breathlessness since 3 days, pedal edema since 1 month.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 20 years back , then she developed DM, hypothyroidism and was on regular medication since then.Pt has H\/O SOB on and off since 6 months which was initially of grade 2 then progressed to grade 4 since then for which she visited cardiologist in our hospital and is on Aspirin , Atorvas, Clopidogrel since then .Patient developed pedal edema pitting type since 1 month which gradually progressed to anasarca.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe developed severe episode of sob for which she visited a local doctor and managed conservatively.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Jan 15th , patient had 1 episode of sudden loss of consciousness and was taken to a local hospital and from there she was referred to another \u0026nbsp;hospital.On the way to the hospital, pt had an episode of involuntary micturition and sob and LOC( regained consciousness after 1 hr)associated with involuntary movements for which she was admitted and discharged after 3 days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince yesterday morning patient developed SOB admitted in a local hospital and suffered a cardiac arrest( and revived after 10 mins)and referred to our hospital.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient now complains of pain abdomen since 1 day and patient hasn’t passed stools since 5 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"MsoNormal\"\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"MsoNormal\"\u003Ek\/c\/o
